Well-designed unified decoder-only architecture with thoughtful component choices (modality-specific MoE, Scale-Aware Adapter) that effectively handles heterogeneous multimodal tasks

Analysis gaps: no discussion of failure modes or model limitations, lacks analysis of which tasks struggle, no error analysis or qualitative failures, missing comparison of unified vs specialized models benefits
Reproducibility limitations: while hyperparameters provided, reproducing training is prohibitively expensive; model weights and code unavailable; some details relegated to appendices

Technical justification gaps: distillation strategy appears somewhat ad-hoc without principled justification for loss weights and design choices; limited justification for specific architectural decisions over alternatives
